requests.description: Discards unsaved changes to the current record and reloads its last saved values. Bound to Cancel buttons on record pages; on a mini page, or for a new record that was never saved, it closes the page instead.
Closes the currently open page. Bound to buttons, menu items, and page commands to dismiss a record page or mini page, prompting to discard any unsaved changes before the page is closed.

prompt.description: Prompt text sent to Creatio.ai as the user's message; static text or an `$Attribute` view-model binding.

useCurrentSession.description: When `true`, the prompt continues the page context's own AI session (created on first use and reused on subsequent calls). When `false` (or omitted), the prompt goes to the last open chat if the AI panel is open, or a new chat is opened with the prompt.

requests.description: Sends a prompt to Creatio.ai: opens the AI chat panel and posts the prompt into a chat session. Bound to buttons (the "Creatio.ai action" of the Designer's event panel).

defaultValues.description: Column values pre-filled on the new record page; each entry is `{ attributeName, value }` where `value` may be a constant, a lookup record Id or a `{ value, displayValue }` pair, or an `$Attribute` binding; entries with a falsy value are dropped. Optional - omit it to open the page with the entity's own defaults.

entityName.description: Schema name of the entity to create a new record of (e.g. "Contact"). Provide it for a button that always adds the same entity. On a list "New" action you may omit it and set `itemsAttributeName` instead - the handler then resolves the entity from that collection's bound data source. At least one of `entityName`, `itemsAttributeName`, or `entityPageName` must be present, otherwise the handler shows a settings error and opens nothing.

entityPageName.description: Schema name of a specific add page to open for the new record (for example a typed card page). Usually stamped by the platform's quick-add menu items (the in-page typed-page "New <type>" menu stamps the record-type default value instead, not this field); author it directly only to force a particular add page. When set it satisfies the settings check on its own - the entity is derived from the page - so `entityName` may be omitted.

itemsAttributeName.description: Name of the list collection attribute (the grid's items attribute, e.g. "DataGrid_6m6ky7l") whose bound data source supplies `entityName` when `entityName` is not given. Author it without a leading `$`; ignored when `entityName` is set.

requests.description: Opens a blank add page to create a new record of an entity, optionally pre-filling column values. Bound to "New" buttons wired to the "Open new record" action of the Designer's event panel, and to the quick-add and typed-page menu items the platform generates from them.

config.description: Load options for the single-source load path (`dataSourceName`) - for example the load type and whether the previous load parameters are reused. Not part of the refresh scenario: when `refreshDataConfig` is present the platform reloads through it and never reads this key. The Designer nevertheless stamps a constant `{ "loadType": "reload" }` into every saved refresh binding, so tolerate that key when reading an existing page and do not author it on a new refresh button.

dataSourceName.description: Name of a single page data source to load, as declared in the page's `modelConfig` - the programmatic/advanced load path. Ignored when `refreshDataConfig` is set; with neither parameter present the request loads nothing.

parameters.description: Data-source parameters (record filters, primary-column values) applied to the single-source load selected by `dataSourceName`. Programmatic/advanced - the refresh scenario reloads each data source with its own last load parameters instead.

primaryDisplayFilterValue.description: Text added to the single-source load as a primary-display-value filter, for search-style loads over `dataSourceName`. Programmatic/advanced; unused by the refresh scenario.

refreshDataConfig.description: Refresh scenario for the page's data sources, and the only parameter a "Refresh data" button needs. Its presence makes this request a page refresh: the platform reloads data sources according to `mode`, and the single-source parameters (`dataSourceName`, `config`, `parameters`, `primaryDisplayFilterValue`) no longer apply. The Designer's default is `{ "mode": "RefreshAll" }`.

showSuccessMessage.description: Whether a "Data has been refreshed" message is shown once every requested data source, and the data sources depending on them, have finished loading. NOT opt-in on a button: when a `crt.Button` `clicked` binding carries a `params` object without this key, the platform sets it to `true` at page init, so a refresh button shows the message unless `false` is authored explicitly. Bindings on other view elements (a `crt.MenuItem`, for example) are not defaulted and stay silent when the key is absent.

requests.description: Reloads page data: either refreshes the page's data sources as a group (`refreshDataConfig`) or loads one named data source (`dataSourceName`). Bound to a button or menu item `clicked` wired to the Designer's "Refresh data" action, which authors the group refresh; the single-source form is programmatic/advanced and is not what that action produces.

modelInitConfigs.description: Initial model configuration forwarded to the opened page: for each entry, which model to seed (`name`), the record to load (`recordId`), the mode (`action`: `edit` / `add` / `copy`), and `defaultValues` to pre-fill. Use it to open a page already scoped to a specific record, or to a new record with defaults.

parameters.description: Page-parameter values passed to the opened page, keyed by page-parameter name; values may be static constants or `$Attribute` view-model bindings. The target page reads them through its `crt.PageParametersDataSource`.

schemaName.description: Schema name (code) of the page to open, not its display caption (e.g. "OrderProductCatalogPage"). Required: the handler shows a settings-error dialog and opens nothing when it is empty. Authored via the "Open specific page" action's page picker, or supplied as a literal / `$Attribute` binding from custom code.

skipUnsavedData.description: Only affects card pages. When `false`, a card with unsaved changes is saved before the target page opens and the page opens only if the save succeeds; when `true` or omitted, the page opens without saving. Rarely authored; most page surfaces leave it unset.

requests.description: Opens a Freedom UI page by its schema name, optionally passing page-parameter values and model init configs. Bound to buttons and menu items wired to the "Open specific page" action of the Designer's event panel. On a card page the current record's unsaved changes can be saved first before the target page opens.

convertInPDF.description: Whether to convert the generated report to PDF.

dataSourceName.description: Data source whose records are printed: the page's primary data source when printing the current record, or the selected list/view element data source when printing a records list. The handler always requires `templateId`, `printableCaption` and `dataSourceName` together; in the designer's menu mode only `dataSourceName` (optionally with `filters`) is authored, while `templateId` and `printableCaption` are filled at runtime by the generated menu items.

filters.description: Collection-filter binding that limits the print to the records selected in the list. When set, records are printed by filter. When not set, the handler prints the active record resolved from dataSourceName; if that record is unsaved (Add state) or cannot be resolved, nothing is printed and an info message is shown. Canonical list-page shape (designer parity, prints the checked rows and falls back to the active row when nothing is checked): "$<GridItems> | crt.ToCollectionFilters : '<GridItems>' : $<Grid>_SelectionState | crt.SkipIfSelectionEmpty : $<Grid>_SelectionState" - substitute the page's real grid collection and selection-state attribute names from its bundle.

printableCaption.description: Caption of the printable (SysModuleReport.Caption); also used as the downloaded file name. Validation-required on direct calls. In menu mode it is stamped automatically onto each generated menu item from SysModuleReport.Caption; the Interface Designer never writes it.

templateId.description: Id of the SysModuleReport printable to generate; on direct/programmatic calls it is validation-required together with printableCaption and dataSourceName. Omitting it (with dataSourceName set) switches the button into the declarative menu mode: the platform expands it into a menu of every printable available for the data source's entity, stamping templateId and printableCaption onto each menu item at runtime. The Interface Designer only ever authors the menu-mode shape (dataSourceName, optionally filters) and never writes templateId itself.

requests.description: Generates and downloads a report (printable) for the current record or a filtered set of records, optionally converting it to PDF. Bound to print buttons and their generated report menu items.

dataSourceName.description: Data source of the list whose selected records the process runs for (`ForTheSelectedRecords` run type).

filters.description: Collection-filter binding selecting the records to run the process for; paired with `dataSourceName` (`ForTheSelectedRecords` run type).

notificationText.description: Text of the start notification; a default is used when not set. Applies when `showNotification` is true.

parameterMappings.description: Single-entry map { "<ParameterCODE>": "<sourceColumn>" }: the first key is the code of the process input parameter that receives each matched record (`ForTheSelectedRecords` run type); extra entries and the column values are ignored by the client handler.

processName.description: Code (schema name) of the business process to run, not its display caption.

processParameters.description: Input parameters passed to the process, keyed by process parameter code (not caption); values may be static constants or `$Attribute` view-model bindings. A key that does not match a real parameter code is silently dropped by the core.

processRunType.description: How the process is run: `RegardlessOfThePage` (no record context), `ForTheSelectedPage` (the current record), or `ForTheSelectedRecords` (records selected in a list). Determines which of the other parameters apply.

recordIdProcessParameterName.description: Code of the process parameter that receives the current record's Id; typically used with the `ForTheSelectedPage` run type.

resultParameterNames.description: Codes of the process output parameters to read back after the run (applies to non-`ForTheSelectedRecords` run types).

saveAtProcessStart.description: Whether to save the current record before the process starts.

selectionStateAttributeName.description: View-model attribute holding the list's selection state; reset after the process starts (`ForTheSelectedRecords` run type).

showNotification.description: Whether to show a notification when the process starts.

sorting.description: Sort order for the matching records (`ForTheSelectedRecords` run type); each entry is `{ columnName, direction }`.

requests.description: Runs a business process - with no record context, for the current record, or for the records selected in a list - optionally saving the record first and notifying when it starts. Bound to buttons and menu items.

dataSourceName.description: Name of the page data source to save, as declared in the page's `modelConfig`. Only this data source is persisted; the rest of the page is left untouched.

parameters.description: Data-source parameters identifying the row being persisted. Author a single `primaryColumnValue` entry whose `value` names the view-model attribute holding the record Id; the resolved value becomes the update query's primary-column filter (updates send only the changed attribute values; inserts send all the data source's bound values and need no filter).

requests.description: Persists the pending changes of a single named data source of the current page; whenever a record is saved, the platform record-save pipeline emits one such request per data source that has changes to persist (the standard full page save is crt.SaveRecordRequest). Bound to buttons that save one data source without running the full page save, and intercepted in page handlers to run logic around each data-source save.

messageTextAfterCompletion.description: Text of the completion message; the localized default ("Data saved successfully") is used when not set. Authored via the Designer's "Message text" input, usually as a `#ResourceString(<key>)#` reference to a page resource. Only shown as a notification together with `showSuccessMessage: true`; otherwise it is announced to screen readers only.

preventCardClose.description: Keeps the page open after a successful save. When `false` or omitted, a record page opened in add or copy mode navigates back after the save (an edit-mode page always stays open), and a mini page is closed after any successful save. Authored via the Designer's "Stay on page after record is created" checkbox.

reloadSavedRecord.description: Only applies together with `preventCardClose`: after a new (add or copy mode) record is saved and its page stays open, `true` reloads the record from the server so server-side changes (for example legacy autonumbering) appear instantly. Authored via the Designer's "Reload saved record" checkbox, shown once "Stay on page after record is created" is checked.

showSuccessMessage.description: Whether to show a success message after the record is saved: when `true`, the completion message is displayed as a notification; when `false` or omitted, it is only announced to screen readers. The OOTB page templates set it to `true` on the standard Save button.

requests.description: Saves the current record page: persists every page data source with pending changes, then handles the page-level concerns - the completion notification, the card state, and closing a new record's card (the targeted single-data-source tool underneath it is crt.SaveDataRequest). Bound to Save buttons on record pages and mini pages via the "Save data" action of the Designer's event panel.

entityName.description: Schema name of the entity whose record edit page is opened (e.g. "Contact"). Provide it for a button that opens a specific record. On a list or detail row action you may omit it and set `itemsAttributeName` instead - the handler then resolves the entity from that collection's bound data source (falling back to the page's primary data source when the attribute is not bound). At least one of `entityName` or `itemsAttributeName` must be present, otherwise the handler shows a settings error and opens nothing.

itemsAttributeName.description: Name of the list/detail collection attribute the record belongs to (the grid's items attribute, e.g. "DataGrid_6m6ky7l" or "GridDetail_h7omalt"), used to resolve `entityName` from that data source when `entityName` is not given. Author it (without a leading `$`) on a grid row's primary-column link or row menu action so the row opens its own entity; ignored when `entityName` is set.

recordId.description: Primary-key value (Id) of the record to open; required - the handler shows a settings error and opens nothing when it is null or an empty string (`0` is a valid Id). Usually an `$Attribute` binding to the row's Id (e.g. "$Items.PDS_Id" or "$GridDetail_h7omalt.<DS>_Id"), an `@event` value, or a literal Id. Three shapes are accepted and all are reduced to the Id by the navigation layer: a Guid string, a numeric primary key, or a whole `LookupValue` (`{ value, displayValue }`). So a lookup column of the current page is bound as-is, without extracting `.value` (e.g. "$PDS_CreatedBy_vmpu5u4"), which is also what the Designer's "Open existing record" action emits; for that case set `entityName` to the schema the lookup REFERENCES, not the entity of the page the button lives on.

requests.description: Opens the edit page of an existing record so the user can view or change it. Bound to record links (a list row's primary-column link), row "Open" menu actions, and buttons wired to the "Open existing record" action of the Designer's event panel. Prompts to discard unsaved changes on the current page before navigating.

allowedFileTypes.description: Comma-separated, case-insensitive allow-list of file types; each item is `.ext`, `ext`, `mime/type`, or `mime/*`. Empty or absent allows every type except those in the `FileExtensionsDenyList` system setting, which always applies.

fileEntitySchemaName.description: Entity schema that stores the uploaded file (default `SysFile`); runtime-required and derived by the platform from the `crt.FileList` named by `viewElementName`. Hand-author only in an advanced scenario with no file list; an authored value overrides the derived one.

fileGroup.description: Id of the file group the upload is filed under; derived by the platform from the target `crt.FileList` (the OOTB Attachments group is `efbf3a0d-d780-465a-8e4b-8c0765197cfb`). Author only in advanced scenarios; an authored value overrides the derived one.

files.description: Files to upload, carried as the `@event.files` event binding. The platform wires it automatically on a `crt.FileList`'s `fileDropped` / `uploadClicked` outputs; hand-author it only when wiring the request to a `crt.FileDrop`'s `fileDropped`, where nothing is derived and the storage parameters must be authored too. Never set it on a button's `clicked` binding - a click carries no files, so the platform opens the file picker before uploading.

itemsAttributeName.description: View-model attribute backing the target `crt.FileList`'s items collection; derived by the platform from that list. Hand-author only in an advanced scenario; an authored value overrides the derived one.

maximumAllowedFileSize.description: Maximum size of one uploaded file, in megabytes; the effective limit is the minimum of this value and the `MaxFileSize` system setting, and when unset `MaxFileSize` alone applies. The designer enforces a minimum of 1.

recordColumnName.description: Column on the file entity that links each file to its parent record (default `RecordId`); runtime-required and derived by the platform from the target `crt.FileList`. Hand-author only in an advanced scenario; an authored value overrides the derived one.

recordEntitySchemaName.description: Entity schema of the parent record the files attach to; derived by the platform from the entity behind the target `crt.FileList`'s `masterRecordColumnValue` binding, and left unset when that cannot be resolved (this parameter has no page-defaults fallback). Hand-author only in an advanced scenario; an authored value overrides the derived one.

recordId.description: Id of the parent record the files attach to; runtime-required and derived by the platform from the target `crt.FileList`'s `masterRecordColumnValue` binding - the file list must carry that property (the Designer's attachments template sets `"$Id"`) or the upload is rejected. A `LookupValue` is unwrapped to its `value`. Uploading to a non-`SysFile` storage on an unsaved record is rejected with a notification. Hand-author only in an advanced scenario; an authored value overrides the derived one.

tag.description: Optional tag stamped on the uploaded file records; derived by the platform from the target `crt.FileList` when configured there. Author only in advanced scenarios; an authored value overrides the derived one.

viewElementName.description: Name of the `crt.FileList` view element on the same page that this upload targets - the standard page contract, and the only storage-targeting parameter such a page authors by hand (optional upload restrictions like `allowedFileTypes` / `maximumAllowedFileSize` may be authored alongside it). At page load the platform reads that file list to derive the storage parameters below. Either name a `crt.FileList` here, or (advanced, no file list on the page) hand-author `recordId`, `recordColumnName`, and `fileEntitySchemaName` instead; when this parameter is absent or matches no `crt.FileList`, page defaults derived from the primary data source apply (`SysFile` storage, `RecordId` link column, the primary record's Id).

requests.description: Uploads one or more files and attaches them to a record, targeting the `crt.FileList` named by `viewElementName`. Bound to a button or menu item `clicked`, or to a `crt.FileList`'s `fileDropped` / `uploadClicked` outputs; the platform derives the storage parameters from that file list at page load, so a standard page authors only `viewElementName` plus optional upload restrictions.

$context.description: The view-model context in which the request was triggered. Injected by the platform at dispatch time, never set via the binding's `params`.

$initialEvent.description: The original UI event that triggered the request.

scopes.description: The scope chain of the request. Populated by the platform from the emitting view element, never set via the binding's `params`.

type.description: Request type discriminator, e.g. "crt.ClosePageRequest". Set implicitly by the `request` field of the request binding, never set via the binding's `params`.

attributeName.description: Name of the entity column to pre-fill on the new record.

value.description: Value to set on that column: a constant, a lookup record Id or a `{ value, displayValue }` pair (the pair carries the display value, so the platform does not resolve it again), or an `$Attribute` view-model binding. Entries with a falsy value (null, empty string, 0, false) are dropped by the add flow - a default cannot clear a column.

aggregationValue.description: it's string, because string | number is not supported in OpenApi

filters.type: (BooleanComparisonFilter | MathComparisonFilter | StringComparisonFilter | DateComparisonFilter | RelativeDateComparisonFilter | LookupComparisonFilter | IsNullComparisonFilter | IsNotNullComparisonFilter | FilterGroup)[]

JsonData.type: string | number | boolean | null | JsonObject | JsonData[]
JsonData.description: Any JSON-serializable value: a primitive, a JsonObject, or an array of JsonData.

attributeName.description: Name of the model attribute to seed.

value.description: Value to seed the attribute with. For a lookup attribute, either the record Id or a `{ value, displayValue }` pair - the pair carries the display value, so the platform does not resolve it again.

action.description: Mode the target model is initialized in.

defaultValues.description: Attribute values to pre-fill on the model.

name.description: Name of the model (from the target page's modelConfig) to initialize.

recordId.description: Primary-key value of the record to load into the model.

type.description: Kind of parameter; authored bindings normally use "primaryColumnValue". These four are the only kinds a page schema may author: the platform enum also carries the internal sentinels "empty" and "never", which the data-load pipeline produces for itself and the authored-parameter converter does not handle, so authoring either one fails the save whenever the request must target rows (updates and deletes; inserts ignore parameters).

value.description: Parameter value; for "primaryColumnValue", the name of the view-model attribute holding the record Id.

excludedDataSourceNames.description: Names of data sources to leave untouched by a `RefreshAll` refresh. Ignored when `mode` is `RefreshSpecific`.

mode.description: Which data sources the refresh covers. `RefreshAll` reloads every data source of the page that does not depend on another data source - a dependent source is reloaded as a consequence of the source it depends on, never on its own - skipping dynamic data sources and the names listed in `excludedDataSourceNames`. `RefreshSpecific` reloads only the data sources named in `targetDataSourceNames`, which must then hold at least one name - an empty list raises an error and nothing is reloaded.

targetDataSourceNames.description: Names of the data sources to reload when `mode` is `RefreshSpecific`; at least one name is required in that mode, and an empty list raises an error instead of reloading anything. A named data source that depends on another name in the same list is dropped, because reloading the one it depends on already reloads it. Ignored when `mode` is `RefreshAll`.

params.valueType: string | boolean | number | null | undefined | RequestParamsBindingConfig | RequestParamBindingConfigValue[] | LocalizableStringArray

RequestParamBindingConfigValue.type: string | boolean | number | null | undefined | RequestParamsBindingConfig | RequestParamBindingConfigValue[] | LocalizableStringArray

visible.description: Indicates whether the column is included in the result set.
